reconstructed_statements: The model consists of site_family, edge_family, and configuration_family.
The range_or_domain of local_value_at is the set {-1, 1}.
local_value_at is indexed_by configuration_family and site_family.
The regular_degree of site_family with respect to edge_family is 2.
The edge_endpoint_structure of edge_family is defined by edge_left and edge_right mapping to site_family.
The range_or_domain of J is real_domain.
The range_or_domain of h is real_domain.
The range_or_domain of beta is real_domain.

For any configuration ?1, its energy is equal to the real_add of: (1) the real_negate of the real_multiply of J and the finite_fold (using real_add, with identity 0) over edge_family of the real_multiply of local_value_at of ?1 at edge_left of edge ?2 and local_value_at of ?1 at edge_right of edge ?2; and (2) the real_negate of the real_multiply of h and the finite_fold (using real_add, with identity 0) over site_family of local_value_at of ?1 at site ?3.
For any configuration ?1, its weight is equal to the real_exp of the real_negate of the real_multiply of beta and the energy of ?1.
partition is equal to the finite_fold (using real_add, with identity 0) over configuration_family of the weight of configuration ?1.
For any configuration ?1, its probability is equal to the real_divide of the weight of ?1 by partition.
